description: This Java interface defines a builder for constructing responses to 'RetrieveFeatureDefinition' commands within a live command processing context, specifically for feature definition retrieval in a signaling or messaging system. It provides methods to generate successful responses with feature definitions and error responses for inaccessible or non-existent features.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending LiveCommandAnswerBuilder.QueryCommandResponseStep, specialized for building responses to RetrieveFeatureDefinition commands.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: A nested interface within RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder that provides factory methods to create successful or error responses.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved FeatureDefinition, indicating successful retrieval.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating that the feature definition is not accessible or does not exist.
